summary: Helport AI Limited filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for the six months ended December 31, 2025 (first half fiscal year 2026). The filing includes a press release, financial statements, and disclosure of ordinary shares and warrants outstanding. It highlights a 7.7% revenue increase to $17.7 million, net loss of $1.7 million, and provides updates on product launches and business expansion. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring—is announced. This is a routine earnings report and business update by a foreign private issuer, not triggering any special-situations classification.
